# BPMN fixture

`simple-process.bpmn` is an independently constructed example for File Viewer tests
and public demos. It contains no material from issue attachments. It is dedicated
to the public domain under [CC0-1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/).
It may be copied, modified and redistributed, including in the public demo.

The pizza attachment from GitHub issue #297 is a separate, local-only regression
input. It is not included here and no redistribution license is assumed for it.
